definition.name: Signed ordinary Rust scratch refusal and fresh-state packet

steps.name: Install the existing bounded compiler namespace and pinned bindings
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
cargo fetch --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Read only this run's identity-checked existing native products
Check captured-source and exact-outcome refusal controls
Execute original signed programme and six ordinary filesystem refusal calls
Retain bounded diagnostic evidence including failures

with.name: rust-scratch-refusals-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/compatibility-execution-report.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/build/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/build/component.wit
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/node/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/node/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-scratch-refusals/node/controls/*.json

reviewReason: Reviewed security fork identities only; commands, permissions, inputs, conditions and historical coverage are preserved.
